svg.title: ASSEMBLE & LOAD · no trimming
svg.desc: 3 Snap the empty front and back together, supporting each of the four joints. Glue the joints if needed and let cure. 4 Slide the whole uncut Instax Mini sheet in from the left for landscape or the bottom for portrait. The wide caption border trails behind.

g.text: Join the front and back before loading the photo.
FRONT · ornament down on a soft cloth
Align all 4 forks; press near each joint.
Glue joints if needed; let cure before loading.
Narrow border first, gently to the firm stop.
Wide border trails at the left
